issues.description: Method Stock.take(String): the problem statement UML and the reference solution declare Stock.take to return int (using -1 to indicate failure and the remaining quantity on success), but the template implementation declares Stock.take to return boolean. This return-type mismatch between the template and the specification/solution will confuse students and prevent the SealSaloon logic (which expects an int sentinel -1 and decremented remaining quantity) from compiling or behaving correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Stock.take method signature and implementation to match the specification and solution: make it return int, return -1 when the ingredient is not found or quantity < 1, otherwise decrement the ingredient quantity and return the remaining quantity. Update any comments or documentation in the template to reflect the int-returning semantics so students implement SealSaloon against the correct API.
